title: Peter's Confession and the Cost of Discipleship

questions.question: When the Pharisees and Sadducees came to test Jesus, what did they ask Him to show them?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:1 (ESV): "And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and to test him they asked him to show them a sign from heaven."

questions.question: Jesus said the Pharisees and Sadducees know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but they cannot interpret what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:3 (ESV): "...You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times."

questions.question: What is the only sign Jesus says will be given to "an evil and adulterous generation"?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:4 (ESV): "An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah."

questions.question: When Jesus warned the disciples to "Watch and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees," what did the disciples initially think He was talking about?
options: Because they bought bread from Samaritans
Because they had eaten leavened bread falsely
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:7 (ESV): "And they began discussing it among themselves, saying, 'We brought no bread.'"

questions.question: After Jesus reminded them of the loaves and fishes, the disciples realized He was not talking about bread, but to beware of what?
options: The teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees
questions.correctAnswer: The teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:12 (ESV): "Then they understood that he did not tell them to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

questions.question: When Jesus arrived in the district of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?" Which of these was NOT one of their answers?
options: Jeremiah or one of the prophets
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:14 (ESV): "And they said, 'Some say John the Baptist, others say Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets.'"

questions.question: When Jesus asked, "But who do you say that I am?", how did Simon Peter reply?
options: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
"You are the true King of Israel."
"You are the holy prophet raised from the dead."
questions.correctAnswer: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:16 (ESV): "Simon Peter replied, 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.'"

questions.question: Jesus told Peter that this truth was not revealed to him by "flesh and blood," but by whom?
options: My Father who is in heaven
questions.correctAnswer: My Father who is in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:17 (ESV): "And Jesus answered him, 'Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah! For flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say He would build upon the "rock"?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:18 (ESV): "And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it."

questions.question: Jesus said He would give Peter the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and whatever he binds on earth shall be what?
options: Written in the book of life
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:19 (ESV): "I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven."

questions.question: From that time, Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things, and be killed, and be raised on what day?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:21 (ESV): "...and be killed, and on the third day be raised."

questions.question: How did Peter react when Jesus foretold His death?
options: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, "Far be it from you, Lord!"
Peter wept and tore his cloak
Peter praised God for the plan of salvation
Peter swore he would die with Him immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, "Far be it from you, Lord!"
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:22 (ESV): "And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, 'Far be it from you, Lord! This shall never happen to you.'"

questions.question: What was Jesus' sharp response to Peter's rebuke?
options: "Get behind me, Satan! You are a hindrance to me."
"Blessed are you for your loyalty, but you speak as a man."
"Do not speak of what you cannot comprehend."
questions.correctAnswer: "Get behind me, Satan! You are a hindrance to me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:23 (ESV): "But he turned and said to Peter, 'Get behind me, Satan! You are a hindrance to me. For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man.'"

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples: "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his...?"
options: Wealth and give to the poor
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:24 (ESV): "Then Jesus told his disciples, 'If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.'"

questions.question: Jesus asked what it will profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 16:26 (ESV): "For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his soul? Or what shall a man give in return for his soul?"

key_verse_text: Simon Peter replied, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
